restored-five-local-shadow-v1.rule: deterministic_facts are authoritative; payload summary may be machine-derived, but payload data_gaps/conflicts can contain model prose and MUST NOT be treated as authoritative.

restored-five-local-shadow-v2.rule: payload summary, net_new_delta, data_gaps, conflicts and execution_authorized are machine-derived from durable source facts. Model prose is isolated under model_advisory and is never authoritative.

downstream_rule: Prefer v2. For v1, use deterministic_facts plus immutable receipt/late-verification evidence and ignore model-derived payload conflicts/gaps for decisions.
substantive_work_rule: Shadow artifacts never prove external research, trading edge, or production execution.
mutation_rule: Shadow outputs and reconciliations are append-only evidence and may not rewrite worker canonical state.
